- **Work is in progress.** `full_loop_runner.clj` and `full_loop_runtime.clj` in futon2 have uncommitted changes. No commits yet. The runner file is where the packet told it to work.

**Why follow-mode might not show it** (I haven't checked this): the job record has `session-id: null`, while the roster lists zai-1 with session `47ab93d3…` and a cwd of `storage/futon7a/customer-sims/2026-09-29`. That cwd is left over from its earlier customer-sims work. If follow-mode finds the agent's activity by session id or cwd, it may be watching the old session and missing this job's activity. I can look at how agent-follow-mode chooses what to follow if you want.

The job has run 35 minutes. My park's deadline is 04:48, and I'll wake then even if zai-1 hasn't belled back.

My guessed function name didn't resolve, which caused the NPE. The reloads themselves ran. I'm checking again with the actual function name.zai-1 finished the change, and I've reviewed it and put it in the running server. Click 14 of 20 (`wm-demo-click-06`) started at about 04:50, and a background watcher will tell me when it finishes. If this click selects the M-self-documenting-stack work again, it won't show the ask, so I'll keep firing until one hits a refusal.

**The change:** commit `6a34c7f` in futon2. When a click abstains because a target has no admitted interpretation, it:
1. asks once for the first such target;
2. decides again in the same click if an interpretation was published;
3. writes the ask into the run record under `:interpretation-ask`.

The answering seat is codex-proof2c by default.

**What I checked:**
- **The diff:** I read the runner and runtime changes. The ask reads the refusal list from the same place the run record takes it, and I confirmed that list against the 03:0x abstained record. M-self-documenting-stack is one of the refused targets there, filed under this refusal.
- **Test adequacy:** tests (b) and (c), and the bug zai-1 planted, cover "asks once", "a decline is recorded" and "never asks when something was selected". Test (a) has a gap: its judge is a counter that abstains on its first call and selects on its second, whatever the interpretation store holds. So it shows the click decides again, not that the real decision uses the new interpretation. The live click is what checks that.
- **Re-execution:** I didn't rerun any tests. zai-1 reported the suites green and I took that report.
- **Reload:** I reloaded `full-loop-runner`, `wm.click-ask` and `full-loop-runtime` into the futon3c JVM from master. The production defaults now include the ask function.

**What the click should show:** most open missions are still refused for having no interpretation. So this click should ask about one, and then either publish it and select that mission, or record why the seat declined. I'll report which happened when the watcher wakes me.

**Still owed:** the receipt still records `:commit nil` after a real commit.
